svg.title: 04 | Classical EEG–Gaze Validation Comparison
svg.desc: Executed 18-person ZuCo 2.0 Stage-04 classical comparison: 630 original 12-second paired feature rows, 371 Train windows from eleven people, 99 Validation windows from three people, 160 Test windows reserved. On 99 Validation windows, gaze Random Forest leads seven predefined models with Macro F1 0.6244, Balanced Accuracy 0.6231 and Accuracy 0.6465. Fixed equal-weight late fusion scores Macro F1 0.5643, gaze logistic 0.5472, EEG forest 0.5139, EEG logistic 0.4545, early-fusion logistic 0.4518, and class prior 0.3774. All models produced 693 Validation model/window predictions; 21 descriptive model/person rows show gaze-forest Macro F1 varying from 0.3478 to 0.7654 across the three people. No Test scoring, independently established EEG-eye synchronisation or cognitive interpretation is claimed.

g.text: 18 people | 371 Train windows (11 people) | 99 Validation (3 people) | Test unscored
Gaze forest led seven candidates; per-person F1 ranged 0.3478–0.7654; Test unscored.
Observed: gaze forest F1 0.6244 > late equal fusion 0.5643 > gaze logistic 0.5472; 99 Validation windows.
